text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I'm starving~.
GⅠ races really do work up an appetite, after all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: However... Ngh, it's just out of reach...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, one shio ramen, and...
Tannhauser, what would you like?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: One salt and one soy sauce, please!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Nature was like five times more
amazing than I could've ever imagined.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"During the race, my stomach and back were tingling all over,
and I lost to her sheer spirit. It's so frustrating."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still...
there's next time, right? Yeah, next time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna eat today!
You can't race on an empty stomach!
